description: Version history for the film folder (the working directory, or `dir`). save records every file with a message and the prompt that led to it; unchanged footage is stored once. list shows the history. restore puts the folder back to a version: unsaved work is saved first and the restore becomes a new version, so nothing is ever lost. diff shows which files changed between two versions (or a version and now), with a line diff for text files such as the edit.

dir.description: Film folder. Default: the working directory.

id.description: restore: the version to go back to, e.g. v3.

message.description: save: what changed, in one line.

model.description: save: the model that made it.

prompt.description: save: the user's request that led to this version.

name: versions
title: Save, list, restore and compare versions
